working_definition: Early-dataset (0-24h APF, 0h/12h/24h) cluster typed by the authors as Tm9; cluster is composed primarily of developing Tm9 neurons (immature). Authors left the subtypes unsplit in the early data.
searches_performed: OLS4 REST search fbbt "immature" medulla/transmedullary/amacrine terms

best_match.fbbt_definition: Immature form of the transmedullary neuron Tm9 (Konstantinides et al., 2022). It is a Notch ON hemilineage secondary neuron, born from a medulla forming neuroblast during the Erm/Ey temporal window (Konstantinides et al., 2022).

justification: Authors' typing taken at face value; stage 0-24h APF so the immature term immature transmedullary neuron Tm9 is the matching developing form. Immature term covers the unsplit subtypes (parent group term chosen over a/b).

other_candidates.fbbt_definition: Transmedullary neuron Tm9 that targets the dorsal half of the lobula. It is distinguished from other Tm9 neurons by its expression of Wnt10 (Kurmangaliyev et al., 2020).
other_candidates.reason_rejected: Mature (adult) form; cluster is 0-24h APF so the immature term is used.
